<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_MarketingCampaign" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/marketing-campaign">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_MarketingCampaign" name="Marketing Campaign" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_CampaignStart" name="Campaign process started">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Objectives</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DefineObjectives" name="Define campaign objectives and target audience">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Objectives</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Objectives_Content</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateContent" name="Create campaign content">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Objectives_Content</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Content_Visuals</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DesignVisuals" name="Design visuals">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Content_Visuals</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Visuals_Channels</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectChannels" name="Select promotion channels">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Visuals_Channels</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Channels_Launch</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_LaunchCampaign" name="Launch campaign">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Channels_Launch</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Launch_Split</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Campaign_Split" name="Campaign running">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Launch_Split</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_Track</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_Leads</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TrackPerformance" name="Track campaign performance in real time">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_Track</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Track_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectLeads" name="Collect generated leads in CRM system">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_Leads</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Leads_FollowUp</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FollowUpLeads" name="Follow up on leads">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Leads_FollowUp</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FollowUp_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Campaign_Join" name="Tracking and follow-up done">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Track_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FollowUp_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Join_Wait</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CampaignPeriodEnded" name="Campaign period ended">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Join_Wait</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Wait_Analyze</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AnalyzePerformance" name="Analyze campaign performance for future optimization">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Wait_Analyze</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Analyze_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_CampaignConcluded" name="Campaign concluded">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Analyze_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Objectives" sourceRef="StartEvent_CampaignStart" targetRef="Task_DefineObjectives"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Objectives_Content" sourceRef="Task_DefineObjectives" targetRef="Task_CreateContent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Content_Visuals" sourceRef="Task_CreateContent" targetRef="Task_DesignVisuals"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visuals_Channels" sourceRef="Task_DesignVisuals" targetRef="Task_SelectChannels"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Channels_Launch" sourceRef="Task_SelectChannels" targetRef="Task_LaunchCampaign"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Launch_Split" sourceRef="Task_LaunchCampaign" targetRef="Gateway_Campaign_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Track" sourceRef="Gateway_Campaign_Split" targetRef="Task_TrackPerformance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Leads" sourceRef="Gateway_Campaign_Split" targetRef="Task_CollectLeads"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Leads_FollowUp" sourceRef="Task_CollectLeads" targetRef="Task_FollowUpLeads"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Track_Join" sourceRef="Task_TrackPerformance" targetRef="Gateway_Campaign_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FollowUp_Join" sourceRef="Task_FollowUpLeads" targetRef="Gateway_Campaign_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_Wait" sourceRef="Gateway_Campaign_Join" targetRef="Event_CampaignPeriodEnded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_Analyze" sourceRef="Event_CampaignPeriodEnded" targetRef="Task_AnalyzePerformance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Analyze_End" sourceRef="Task_AnalyzePerformance" targetRef="EndEvent_CampaignConcluded"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
